main_text.l: etiamsi Diabolus nobis offerat argen-tum, aurum, juvet nos, exhibeat nobis medicamenta, eripiat nos ex carcere credendum esse hoc jussu Dei fieri! Egregius sane Dei amor est, qui tantum commercii cum Diabolo habet! ut ipsummet amantem Daemoniorum focium reddat! Quid vero impedit, quo minus, qui eousque procedit, porro cum Paracelso statuat, Artem Magicam, qua Deus Diabolum, in luce naturae peritissimum, donavit, ut furpandam esse, Diabolum relinquendum: illam Diabolo eripi posse, atque ideo nos in hoc Mundo versari, ut minor a majore discat: Quin &c, si per characteres aliquid boni in nobis fiat, eodem loco habendos essent, ac si essent Plantae; ac etiamsi Diaboli sint, eodem loco id habendum esse, ac si essent pyxides in Pharmacopolio: Et, si Diabolus verbum pro herba sumat, instar herbae id nobis esse debere. Apage cum ejusmodi impietate! cui quae reposui Differt.

page.notes: Printed text is in one column; the catchword and signature are absent. Some words are doubtful due to the scan's blurring, notably "furpandam" (probably "usurpandam") and "reposui" (probably "reposui"/"repofui"); the printer's spelling is kept as read. The final word "Differt." is a running signature-like word at the foot right and is transcribed as printed.
